uni_detect.generation_method: PREVIEW: computed via benchmarks-internal pure-Python simulator (same production metric/perturbation/featurization code, no Spark), because this environment's JDK 21 is incompatible with PySpark 3.5's bundled Arrow. Cross-validated against the previous dataset's Spark-run baseline.json (exact match) before being trusted. Re-run `uv run python benchmarks/run_benchmark.py --update-baseline` on JDK 17 to get a Spark-confirmed refresh.
uni_detect.duration_note: Not measured in this session's environment: only JDK 21 is available, and Uni-Detect's Spark/Arrow path requires JDK 17 (see README). These precision/recall/F1/accuracy figures are reused verbatim from a prior run (git f99a32d, computed via the pure-Python provenance harness documented in README.md -- see generation_method) rather than fabricated; a fresh run on JDK 17 would also fill in a real duration_seconds here.
